cardOverview.overviewText: The Axis Bank Privilege Amex Card is a mid-tier lifestyle card offering travel and dining perks. It provides milestone bonus points, quarterly domestic lounge access, and moderate value returns ideal for regular spenders seeking added travel comfort without premium fees.
